claim_text: The orthorhombic-to-tetragonal transition of SC starts at the domain surface and moves inward, finishing within <10 K

steps.observation: Every trace steps down near 150 K; for PC (004) the two branches coexist over a shaded band from ~150 to ~175 K
steps.image_note: the regime labels 'orthorhombic' and 'tetragonal(224)' are written along the bottom axis of F2a; the coexistence band is highlighted in yellow

panels.caption_span: Temperature-dependent XRD 2theta peaks of SC (blue color), PC (red color), and HOC (black color) perovskites in the range from 40.5 to 42.5 . Visual illustration of

steps.observation: Between 138 and 150 K the ~785 nm band grows against the ~745 nm band, earliest and strongest under the 325 nm laser, latest under 633 nm
steps.image_note: '325 nm Laser', '473 nm Laser', '633 nm Laser' are written above the three contour maps; under 325 nm the 785 nm band is already strong at 138 K, under 633 nm only a weak feature appears after ~147 K

panels.caption_span: Contour maps of temperature-dependent PL at Ttrans values ranging from 135 to 150K as a function of excitation wavelength

steps.observation: At 138, 143 and 148 K the ~785 nm share of the spectrum rises as the probe depth falls from 493.7 to 60.6 to 19.6 nm
steps.image_note: the depths delta = 493.7 / 60.6 / 19.6 nm and the isotherm names X-X', Y-Y', Z-Z' are written on the panel; at 148 K the 19.6 nm trace is dominated by the ~800 nm peak while the 493.7 nm trace still peaks at ~745 nm

panels.caption_span: Depth-dependent PL spectra at 138, 143, and 148(X-X,Y-Y , and Z-Z isotherm lines at different penetration depths indicate different ratios of the two phases)

steps.support_basis: shown in the panel, entering by a qualifies edge: a caveat on the claim
steps.observation: The SC TDPL map carries a blank horizontal band with no data from ~150 to ~165 K, exactly where the abrupt SC transition is claimed
steps.image_note: the gap is in the bottom (SC) TDPL panel of F3a only; the HOC panel is continuous across the same window

closing_why: the claim names a fact no panel carries: PL near 750 nm is the orthorhombic phase and near 780 nm the tetragonal phase (linked text F3/F4); F4a and F4b carry no phase label; the transition completes within delta-T_trans < 10 K (linked text F4)
